description_en: Responds to pending confirmation operations (approvals) or clarification questions generated during an agent run to allow the agent to continue execution
description_zh: 响应Agent运行中产生的待确认操作（审批）或澄清问题，使Agent继续执行
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute respond-agent-action --conversation-id '123456789012****#cn-shanghai#1ee04bea-0488-46b6-b85b-827e3cd37e55' --action-id exec:01J5ZKQ8M7N2P4R6T8V0W2X4Y6 --decision allow-once --region cn-hangzhou
name: RespondAgentAction

parameters.help_en: The ID of the operation to be responded to. This value is obtained from the action_id field of the action event in the ChatSse event stream
parameters.help_zh: 待响应操作的ID，来自ChatSse事件流中action事件的action_id字段
parameters.name: action_id

parameters.help_en: The operation type. Valid values: exec (command execution approval), plugin (plugin operation approval), and question (clarification question). If this parameter is not specified, the value is inferred based on the prefix of the actionId
parameters.help_zh: 操作类型。取值：exec（命令执行审批）、plugin（插件操作审批）或question（澄清问题）。不传时按actionId前缀推断
parameters.name: action_kind

parameters.help_en: The agent type. Valid values: MaxAgent (default, MaxCompute intelligent assistant) and DataAgent (data analytics agent)
parameters.help_zh: Agent类型。取值：MaxAgent（默认值，MaxCompute智能助手）或DataAgent（数据分析Agent）
parameters.name: agent_type

parameters.help_en: The approval decision. This parameter is required for approval operations. Valid values: allow-once (allow this time) and deny (reject). The value allow-always is not accepted. This field is ignored for question operations. Use optionIds and freeText to provide answers instead
parameters.help_zh: 审批决定。审批类操作必传，取值：allow-once（本次允许）或deny（拒绝），不接受allow-always。question类操作忽略此字段，改用optionIds与freeText作答
parameters.name: decision

parameters.help_en: The free-text answer for question operations. The maximum length is 2,048 characters. This field is accepted only when the question allows free-text answers
parameters.help_zh: question类操作的自由文本答案，最长2048个字符。仅问题允许自由文本作答时接受
parameters.name: free_text

parameters.help_en: The list of option IDs for question operations. A maximum of 6 items are allowed. For single-choice questions, a maximum of 1 item is allowed. 0 items are allowed, but a non-empty freeText value must be provided in this case
parameters.help_zh: question类操作的选项ID列表，最多6项；单选问题最多1项。允许0项，但此时必须提供非空freeText
parameters.name: option_ids

parameters.help_en: A reserved field. This field is not consumed by the server
parameters.help_zh: 预留字段，当前服务端不消费
parameters.name: response_text

actionId.description_en: The ID of the responded operation

approvalKind.description_en: The operation category. Valid values: exec, plugin, and question

decision.description_en: The effective decision. For approval operations, the value is allow-once or deny. For question operations, the value is resolved
decision.description_zh: 实际生效的决定。审批类为allow-once或deny；question类为resolved

response.description_en: The detailed result of the operation processing. If the response fails, this field contains the cause of the failure, such as empty_answer (no answer provided for a question operation) or unsupported_decision (the approval decision is not accepted, and allowedDecisions is returned to list the valid values)
response.description_zh: 操作处理的详细结果。响应失败时包含失败原因，例如empty_answer（question类未提供答案）、unsupported_decision（审批决定不被接受，同时返回allowedDecisions列出可选值）

reason.description_en: The cause of the failure. For example, empty_answer indicates that no option or text answer was provided for a question operation, and unsupported_decision indicates that the approval decision is not within the accepted range
reason.description_zh: 失败原因。例如empty_answer表示question类操作未提供选项或文本答案，unsupported_decision表示审批决定不在接受范围内

status.description_en: The operation processing status, such as resolved

runId.description_en: The agent run ID to which the operation belongs. If the operation is not associated with a run, an empty string is returned
runId.description_zh: 操作所属的Agent运行ID。未关联运行时为空字符串

success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was successfully responded to

errorCode.description_en: The error code. This field is not returned if the call is successful. If the call fails, a specific error code is returned to help identify the cause of the error
errorCode.description_zh: 错误码。调用成功时不返回该字段；调用失败时返回具体错误码，用于定位错误原因

errorMsg.description_en: The error message. This field is not returned if the call is successful. If the call fails, a human-readable error description is returned
errorMsg.description_zh: 错误信息。调用成功时不返回该字段；调用失败时返回可读的错误描述

httpCode.description_en: The business status code. This field is not returned if the call is successful. If the call fails, the corresponding HTTP error code is returned, such as 400, 403, 404, or 500
httpCode.description_zh: 业务状态码。调用成功时不返回该字段；调用失败时返回对应的HTTP错误码，例如400、403、404、500

requestId.description_en: The request ID. This ID uniquely identifies the request and can be used for troubleshooting and log correlation
requestId.description_zh: 请求ID，唯一标识本次请求，可用于问题排查与日志关联
